contract.note: The ordinary reading fairly concerns mixed accuracy and unreliable cues to errors in contemporaneous systems, without requiring universal failure.

evidence.note: The contemporaneous programming evaluation and small user study document incorrect answers that plausible presentation caused users to miss.
The original January study documents legal factual errors and unreliable model self-assessment. It does not directly measure user detection or establish an all-domain error rate.

reviews.rationale: Contemporaneous studies establish mixed accuracy, missed errors among users, and unreliable model self-assessment. This supports the qualitative observation under the contract's ordinary reading; the domain-specific rates and small user sample do not establish population-wide rates.
